measuredSpectrum.source: Kiehling (1987), spectrophotometry of 60 bright F, G, K and M stars, 320-880 nm in 1 nm steps as normalised magnitudes: Kiehling (1987), A&AS 69, 465; VizieR III/124. Aldebaran is HR 1457.
measuredSpectrum.note: Ground-based photoelectric spectrophotometry, published as magnitudes normalised to the star's own flux near 555 nm; read here as flux 10^(-0.4 m). The calibration is relative, which is all a colour needs. The catalogue gives no observation dates.

crossCheck.source: Burnashev (1985), record 456: a Crimean scan of 1977

gaps.reason: the scan ends near 755 nm; the last value is held to 780 nm, where the observer adds little
